args.message: The three cities with the highest revenue are Bergen, Rome and Vienna, in that order. Bergen has 823 orders, Rome has 752 and Vienna has 570. I counted each city separately by region, so a city name that appears in two regions counts as two cities. Revenue is the sum of order amounts and is used only to rank the cities, so it isn't shown.
